inputs.kind: Requested candidate source profile; must later be derived and joined to the actual captured artifact kind.
inputs.raw_bytes: Original complete source bytes, not caller-provided parsed AST or normalized body.
inputs.expected_sha256: Exact lowercase 64-character digest from captured revision; does not by itself authenticate that revision.
inputs.limits: Explicit local byte, depth and numeric limits; not a replacement for the full capture bundle budget.

output: DecodedBody(kind, exact_schema_ref, schema_digest, body_digest, identity_token, original_bytes, limits); body property returns the complete parsed value afresh.
pattern_semantics: Explicit NonWhitespace and TimestampShape for the two exact pinned schema expressions; unknown expressions refused.
original_semantic_claims: Validity establishes neither satisfaction, achievement, completion, ownership nor authority.
